privacy.title: Manufar Sirri
privacy.s1Body: Great Sport Bets na tattara ƙaramin bayanan sirri da ake buƙata don ƙirƙirar asusu da samun Premium, gami da adiresoshin imel da bayanan biyan kuɗi waɗanda ake sarrafa su cikin aminci ta Stripe (yanar gizo) da Google Play / RevenueCat (Android).
privacy.s2Body: Muna amfani da bayananka don ba da damar samun shawarwarin fare, sarrafa biyan kuɗi, da gudanar da tsarin gayyata. Ba ma sayar da bayanan sirrinku ga wasu.
privacy.s3Body: Muna aiwatar da matakan tsaro na zamani ta Supabase, Stripe, Google Play da RevenueCat don kare bayananka. Duk da haka, babu wata hanyar watsa bayanai ta Intanet da ta kasance 100% amintacciya.
privacy.s4Body: Idan kana da kowace tambaya game da wannan Manufar Sirri, tuntuɓe mu a greatsportbets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Sharuɗɗan Sabis
terms.s1Body: Great Sport Bets yana ba da shawarwarin fare na bayanai da surebets. Ba ma bayar da sabis na caca ko shawara ta kuɗi. Duk ayyukan fare suna kan haɗarin ku.
terms.s2Body: Ana ba da damar Premium ta hanyar biyan kuɗi na lokaci-lokaci a Android (Google Play, ana sarrafa ta RevenueCat) da sayayya na lokaci ɗaya a yanar gizo (ana sarrafa ta Stripe). Biyan kuɗi na lokaci-lokaci na Google Play suna ƙarƙashin manufofin biya da mayarwa na Google Play. Sayayyar yanar gizo ba za a iya mayarwa ba da zarar an ba da damar shiga.
terms.s3Body: An yi tsarin gayyatar mu don amfani na sirri. Cin zarafi, gami da gayyatar kai ko ƙirƙirar asusu ta yaudara, zai haifar da dakatar da asusu da asarar kyaututtuka.
terms.s4Body: Great Sport Bets ba ya ba da tabbacin samun nasara. Ayyukan da suka gabata ba su nuna sakamakon nan gaba ba. Koyaushe yi caca cikin alhaki.

deletion.title: Goge Asusu & Bayanai
deletion.intro: A Great Sport Bets, muna mutunta sirrin ku kuma muna ba da hanya bayyananna don goge asusunku da bayanan ku na sirri.
deletion.warningBody: Goge asusunku na dindindin ne. Za ku rasa damar shiga matsayin Premium, kyaututtukan gayyata, da tarihi. Ba za a iya soke wannan matakin ba.
deletion.step1: Aika imel zuwa <email>{{email}}</email> daga adireshin imel ɗin da ke da alaƙa da asusun Great Sport Bets ɗinku.
deletion.step2: Saka "Buƙatar Goge Asusu" a cikin taken.
deletion.step3: Za a aiwatar da buƙatarku cikin kwanaki 7 na aiki. Za ku sami imel ɗin tabbatarwa da zarar an kammala gogewar.
deletion.deleted2: Bayanan damar shiga Premium da tarihin biya
deletion.deleted3: Hanyoyin haɗin gayyata, lambobin, da tarihi
deletion.deleted4: Saitunan mai amfani da abubuwan da aka fi so
deletion.keptBody: Don bin ka'idojin doka da kuɗi (misali, bayar da rahoton haraji na biyan Stripe da Google Play), muna iya adana ID na ma'amala da metadata har zuwa shekaru 5. Waɗannan bayanan ba su da alaƙa da ainihin ku kuma ana amfani da su ne kawai don bincike.
